title: Edoid languages - Wikipedia
text: The Edoid languages are a few dozen languages spoken in southern Nigeria. Edoid-speaking ethnic groups are predominantly located in the States of Edo and Delta however, smaller Edoid-speaking communities are also present in the states of Ondo, Bayelsa, and Rivers.

title: Ihievbe Language (IHI) – L1 & L2 Speakers, Status... | Ethnologue Free
text: Ihievbe is a stable indigenous language of Nigeria. It belongs to the Niger-Congo language family. The language is used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.
